RagShortTexts: Granada defended the last Islamic redoubt in Iberia from the red hill-fort of the Alhambra.

Variants.Content: Granada flourished as the last independent Muslim bastion in al-Andalus under the Nasrids. Framed by the snowy Sierra Nevada, the red fortress of the Alhambra commanded irrigation networks, silk looms, and steep mountain approaches.
Regular gold coin tributes paid to Castile bought uneasy peace, allowing light jinete cavalry to patrol frontier defiles.
